The '''Rebel Military Base''' was a base used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
The Rebel Military Base saw use following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Situated between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[City/Legends|capital city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], and the Rebel safe haven of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], the base was staffed by a number of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel soldiers]]. Viewed from the top down, the base was shaped in the form of the [[Alliance Starbird]], and consisted of three watch towers and two smaller buildings.<ref name="SWG:RMB" />

[[File:TatooineMilitaryBaseIntact.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Rebel Military Base on Tatooine, prior to its destruction.]]
However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Empire learned of its location, forcing the Rebellion to pack up its base and move elsewhere to avoid Imperial detection. Rumor had it that they relocated to [[Rori/Legends|Rori]],<ref name="P1" /> the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Indeed, the Rebels did [[Rebel Base (Rori)|relocate their base]] to Rori, northwest of its [[Lake Octir]].<ref name="SWG:RB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Rebel Base|Rori}}</ref> Nonetheless, Rebels did remain at the base on Tatooine, where they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the Empire destroyed the base. The debris, [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]], and fallen banners of the Rebel Alliance were left strewn across the desert following the ruthless attack. The new base on Rori had a virtually identical design layout as the one destroyed on Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:RMB" />

Sometime later during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Errik Darksider]] sold the coordinates of the base to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] traveling through [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:ED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RoriRebelMilitaryBase.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The newly built Rebel Military Base on Rori shared a virtually identical design to that of the one on Tatooine.]]
The Rebel Military Base appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RMB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

With the game's release, the base was fully intact.<ref name="SWG:RMB" /> Yet, with the release of the game's first large update, the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 13]], 2003, the base was remodeled by the developers to appear destroyed, and a new base was put on Rori.<ref name="P1" /> The same graphical model for the intact base on Tatooine was used for the new base on Rori.<ref name="SWG:RMB" /><ref name="SWG:RB" /> In game, no explanation was given for why the base was destroyed, and why a new one was built on Rori, but the patch notes offered an explanation. According to the notes, the Rebels "packed up" the Tatooinian base in order to avoid Imperial detection.<ref name="P1" /> Seeing as how the Tatooinian base looked destroyed, and consisted of dead Rebel bodies strewn about, it can be deduced that the Empire destroyed the base before all the Rebels could flee to the new installation on Rori.<ref name="SWG:RMB" />
